chunks: And whatever is in H from Aḥmad ibn Hilāl, I have narrated it from my father and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Hilāl.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an expression indicating the author’s mode of narration
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; part of the author’s transmission route
key_terms.عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلَالٍ: from Aḥmad ibn Hilāl; the named transmitter to whom the chain leads
key_terms.عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah; a link in the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Aḥmad ibn Hilāl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits narrations from Aḥmad ibn Hilāl. It serves as a technical note of transmission, identifying the intermediaries through whom these reports were received.
